mechanism: Build a flat poster world around one dominant geometric motif and one stable protagonist silhouette. Repeatedly fracture and reconstruct the layout through hard-edged crops, diagrams, negative space and key states; peak information density before a short contrastive operational tableau, then resolve established graphic families into one original closing system.

invariants.rule: Establish one dominant motif and stable silhouette immediately.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without anchors the result becomes random collage.

invariants.rule: Keep spatial behavior flat while graphic planes transform.
invariants.ablation_failure: Realistic depth weakens the designed system.

invariants.rule: Use symbolic key states rather than continuous realistic action.
invariants.ablation_failure: Full choreography competes with the graphic transitions.

invariants.rule: Peak density before one quieter contrast state.
invariants.purpose: Creates acceleration and a readable breath.

invariants.rule: Resolve only established graphic families into the endpoint.
invariants.ablation_failure: An unrelated logo or fade does not resolve the system.

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original subject or system whose identity remains stable.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One visible variable that changes in countable causal stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained behavior rule that makes the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: A coherent information order that does not copy source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: One clean physical or graphic consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: A new hierarchy of diegetic cues supporting state changes.

red black white city poster palette
wide-brim opposing figure inside a red ring
the source slash montage and exact final disc composition

instantiations.concept: A tactile paper-cut accessibility explainer centers a folded-corridor motif and evacuation-chair silhouette, rebuilds hinged floor-plan states, pauses on an empty blocked landing and folds all established paper strips into an accessible route badge.
instantiations.prompt_seed: Paper-cut accessibility route system with hinged planar transitions and a four-part information rhythm.

instantiations.concept: An analog music sequencer ident centers a punched-disc motif and mechanical stylus silhouette, rebuilds rhythm lanes and mute states, pauses on an empty locked groove and resolves into a playable loop marker.
instantiations.prompt_seed: Flat analog music system driven by material punch patterns rather than environmental maps.

instantiations.concept: A woven meteorology card centers a braided isobar motif and sensor-kite silhouette, rethreads wind states, pauses on a blank storm latch and knots established fibers into a route forecast seal.
instantiations.prompt_seed: Woven flat-motion weather ident with thread tension and a non-digital contrast state.
